Noto Sans CJK
---

`NotoSansJP-Regular.otf`, `NotoSansSC-Regular.otf` and `NotoSansTC-Regular.otf`
are the region-specific subset fonts of Noto Sans CJK by Google and Adobe, from
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk (`Sans/SubsetOTF/`, commit `165c01b`).

They are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1; see `LICENSE-NOTO-SANS-CJK`.

They are used unmodified, as fallback fonts so Japanese, Simplified Chinese and
Traditional Chinese text renders without relying on fonts installed on the system.
At runtime they are loaded from the `fonts` folder next to the executable.
